church.blurb: Pews, a balcony, and a hole in the floor where the flags gave way.
church.name: St Anne's

churchyard.blurb: Stones, most of them upright. The ground here has been turned over.
churchyard.name: Churchyard

clinic.blurb: Waiting room, two wards, and a generator in the basement.
clinic.name: Ridge Clinic

crossroads.blurb: A fountain, a statue nobody remembers, and four ways to be surrounded.
crossroads.name: The Crossroads

crypt.blurb: Older than the church above it, and it was not built for the dead they put in it.
crypt.name: The Crypt

diner.blurb: Chrome, checked tile, and a griddle somebody left on.
diner.name: The Ridge Diner

east_roof.blurb: Diner to clinic on two planks and a fire escape.
east_roof.name: East Roofs

east_street.blurb: Shopfronts, all of them out. The bus did not get far.
east_street.name: Mill Street

garage.blurb: Two bays, a pit, and a car on the lift that has been there some time.
garage.name: Hollow Auto

gas.blurb: Four pumps under a canopy. Mind where you put the shotgun.
gas.name: The Filling Station

hardware.blurb: Timber, nails, and the ladder to the roofs.
hardware.name: Hollow Hardware

motel_court.blurb: Two storeys of doors that do not lock and a sign that still buzzes.
motel_court.name: Motel Courtyard

motel_roof.blurb: Flat, gravelled, and the only place in town you can see all of it.
motel_roof.name: Motel Roof

motel_rooms.blurb: Eleven rooms off one corridor. Nothing in any of them is yours.
motel_rooms.name: Motel Rooms

north_road.blurb: Uphill, between the railings, towards the one building with a light on.
north_road.name: Church Lane

sewer.blurb: Runs the length of the town, and comes up in three places.
sewer.name: Storm Drain

south_street.blurb: The long way round the back of everything.
south_street.name: Mill Row

west_street.blurb: The road out, if the road out were not full of somebody's lorry.
west_street.name: Ridge Street

bonepicker.desc: Dry, quick, and comes in threes. Nothing left in it to slow it down.
bonepicker.name: Bonepicker

butcher.desc: It does not come through the window. It comes through the wall.
butcher.name: The Butcher

crone.desc: Keeps its distance and throws what is left of its stomach at you.
crone.name: Crone

hound.desc: A round of nothing but these. They come out of the ground burning.
hound.name: Hellhound

husk.desc: Dried out and hard to put down. It does not hurry and does not need to.
husk.name: Husk

leech.desc: It leaps, and what it takes off you it keeps.
leech.name: Leech

reaper.desc: Walks through the boards, through the door and through the room.
reaper.name: The Reaper

ripper.desc: It still runs the way it ran when it was alive. That is the problem.
ripper.name: Ripper

shambler.desc: It was somebody. It is slow until it is not.
shambler.name: Shambler

skitter.desc: Low, fast, and easy to lose in a crowd until it is on your boot.
skitter.name: Skitter

vigil.desc: Boards do not stop it. It comes through the window, not past it.
vigil.name: Vigil

arc.desc: It jumps. Line them up and it goes through the queue.
arc.name: Arc Thrower

bar.desc: Twenty rounds of rifle, automatic. Brace, or it will walk off target.
bar.name: B.A.R.

carbine.desc: Semi-automatic, and accurate the whole length of the high street.
carbine.name: M1 Carbine

double.desc: Two barrels, both at once if you like. Then a very long two seconds.
double.name: Double-Barrel

grease.desc: Slow enough to aim, fast enough to matter. Stamped out of sheet steel.
grease.name: Grease Gun

mg.desc: A hundred and twenty-five without stopping. You will not want to stop.
mg.name: Belt-Fed .30

pistol.desc: Eight rounds of last resort. You start with it; you do not end with it.
pistol.name: M1911

revolver.desc: Six. Make them count, and mind the wrist.
revolver.name: .357 Magnum

smg.desc: Thirty rounds in under three seconds. The corridor gun.
smg.name: Thompson

springfield.desc: Bolt action. One round through four of them if they line up, and they do.
springfield.name: Springfield

thumper.desc: A grenade, thrown very hard, by a tube. Mind the wall in front of you.
thumper.name: Thumper

trench.desc: Eight pellets and a pump. Nothing clears a doorway faster.
trench.name: Trench Gun
